title: Project deletion
statement: The system shall delete a project and all its artifacts only after the project key is typed to confirm, and never delete a path that is not a reqforge repository or contains the workspace.
rationale: Reverse-engineered from the implemented reqforge 0.2 behaviour.

acceptance_criteria.text: Delete requires the matching key and removes the directory with every artifact
Paths that are not reqforge repositories or contain the workspace are refused
